start: A gym member with 8 saved workouts that include Barbell Squat, no workout open

steps.action: Open the Barbell Squat exercise page, tap the History tab
user_sees: One card per past workout, newest first, titled with the routine name (or the date) and the date under it
Stats row 'Kg lifted', 'Sets', 'Best set' like '100 kg × 5'
Each working set numbered; drop sets 'D', failure sets 'F'
must_not: Warm-up sets counted in Kg lifted or Sets
A Best set that is not the heaviest working set

start: A gym member with 8 saved workouts that include Barbell Squat, a workout open with 2 squat sets ticked and 1 not ticked

steps.action: From the live workout, open Barbell Squat's page, History tab
user_sees: First card 'This workout' with 'Ticked sets so far' and badge 'In progress'
Its stats row from the 2 ticked sets only
must_not: The open workout missing from History

steps.action: Go back, tick the third set, open History again

start: A gym member whose open workout has Barbell Squat on two cards (heavy 3 x 5 and back-off 2 x 10)

user_sees: 'This workout' lists the ticked sets of both cards in order
must_not: Back-off sets shown as a second current workout

start: A gym member with an open workout that has Barbell Squat but no set ticked yet

user_sees: 'This workout' with 'No sets ticked yet. They show here as you tick them.'

steps.action: Open Barbell Squat's History tab from that workout
user_sees: No 'This workout' card; the saved workout appears once among the past ones
must_not: The edited workout shown twice (as current and as saved)
